Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal) for filling up research project positions in Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post under this notification is Project Assistant, specifically for individuals with a background in Earth Sciences and Geology.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IISER Bhopal Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post under this specific research project notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's M.Sc. or M.Tech. degree in Geology or Earth Sciences with a minimum of 60% aggregate or CGPA/CPI 7.0 and above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000 plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through Email mode by submitting their complete application as a single PDF file to the designated email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for the IISER Bhopal Project Assistant recruitment is 10-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant post comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Project Assistant post at IISER Bhopal.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application documents be emailed?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their application documents as a single PDF file to [email protected] along with required academic transcripts and CV.
